description: This file defines the implementation of the MotionDetection plugin class for a WPEFramework-based project. It includes method implementations for managing motion detector sensors, handling motion events, and plugin lifecycle management. The code interacts with underlying motion detection hardware or system components via external functions and registers JSON-RPC methods and event callbacks.

classes.name: MotionDetection
classes.description: Implementation of motion detection plugin, handling detection logic, RPC methods, event callbacks, and plugin lifecycle.

methods.name: getMotionDetectors
methods.description: Retrieves a list and information about available motion detectors.

methods.name: arm
methods.description: Arms a specific motion detector sensor based on provided mode.

methods.name: disarm
methods.description: Disarms a specific motion detector sensor.

methods.name: isarmed
methods.description: Checks whether a specified motion detector is armed.

methods.name: setNoMotionPeriod
methods.description: Sets the period of no motion detection for a sensor.

methods.name: getNoMotionPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current no-motion detection period.

methods.name: setSensitivity
methods.description: Sets the sensitivity level for a motion detector.

methods.name: getSensitivity
methods.description: Retrieves current sensitivity settings for a motion detector.

methods.name: getLastMotionEventElapsedTime
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time since the last motion event.

methods.name: setMotionEventsActivePeriod
methods.description: Configures active time ranges during which motion detection is enabled.

methods.name: getMotionEventsActivePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves configured active time periods for motion detection.
